sourceVersion: Fontana Unified 2026-2027 School Calendar, Board Approved 9/25/24
seoTitle: Fontana Unified Calendar 2026-2027 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Fontana Unified Calendar 2026-2027 with first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, minimum days, Spanish PDF, ICS, and Google Calendar download.
calendarNotes: Fontana Unified starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 6, 2026 and ends on May 27, 2027. The board-approved calendar lists Fall Break from November 23-27, Winter Break from December 21-January 8, Spring Break from March 22-26, weekly Wednesday minimum days, elementary and middle school conference minimum days from October 19-23, high school final exam minimum days from December 15-18 and May 25-27, and a Spanish school year calendar PDF. Families can download the official PDF or use the ICS file to add Fontana Unified dates to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fontana Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fontana Unified starts school on Thursday, August 6, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 8, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fontana Unified in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for all grades is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fontana Unified publish a Spanish 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Fontana Unified publishes a Spanish school year calendar PDF for 2026-2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Fontana Unified calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Fontana Unified ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: Are all Fontana Unified schools using the same calendar in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Most Fontana Unified schools use the board-approved 2026-2027 school calendar, but year-round schools, specialized programs, campus events, testing schedules, athletics, and bell schedules may differ. Families should verify school-specific details with the assigned campus.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fontana Unified have school on Wednesdays?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Fontana Unified lists weekly Wednesday minimum days for all schools on the 2026-2027 calendar. Families should confirm exact dismissal times with the student's school.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days does Fontana Unified have in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The board-approved Fontana Unified 2026-2027 calendar lists 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can parents find Fontana Unified bell schedules?
calendarFaqs.a: Bell schedules, start times, dismissal times, and daily schedules are managed by individual Fontana Unified schools. Use the district calendar for school-year dates and the assigned campus for bell schedule details.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fontana Unified have a year-round calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: This page focuses on the Fontana Unified 2026-2027 traditional district calendar. If a student attends a year-round school, specialized program, or campus with separate schedule notices, families should confirm dates with the assigned school.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fontana Unified return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Fontana Unified Winter Break ends Friday, January 8, 2027. January 11, 2027 is listed as a professional development day with no school, so families should verify the first student return date with district or campus announcements.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fontana Unified have school on holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Fontana Unified does not hold regular student attendance on listed district holidays such as Labor Day, Veterans Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Lincoln's Birthday, President's Day, and other holidays on the board-approved calendar.
